translations.idiomatic: Liu Yu dispatched Senior Army Advisor Heng Kaizhi to Yao Xian to negotiate peace; Xian answered through Ji Mo, and formal embassies thereafter crossed without interruption.

sentences.zh: 晉求南鄉諸郡，興許之。

translations.literal: Jin requested the southern Xiang commanderies; Xing granted them.
translations.idiomatic: Jin asked for the Nanxiang cluster of commanderies, and Yao Xing agreed.

sentences.zh: 群臣咸諫以為不可，興曰：「天下之善一也，劉裕拔萃起微，匡輔晉室，吾何惜數郡而不成其美乎！

translations.literal: All ministers remonstrated, deeming it impermissible. Xing said: “The good in the world is one; Liu Yu rose outstanding from the humble and rescued and assisted the Jin house—why should I begrudge several commanderies and not complete his excellence!”
translations.idiomatic: The whole court protested that he must not yield the territory. Yao Xing replied: “Excellence under Heaven is not a zero-sum prize. Liu Yu rose from nowhere to shore up the Jin throne—why should I stint over a few commanderies and deny him this noble deed?”

sentences.zh: 」遂割南鄉、順陽、新野、舞陰等十二郡歸於晉。

translations.literal: Thereupon he ceded Nanxiang, Shunyang, Xinye, Wuyin, and other twelve commanderies, returning them to Jin.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore handed twelve commanderies—including Nanxiang, Shunyang, Xinye, and Wuyin—back to Jin.

sentences.zh: 姚碩德等頻敗楊盛，盛懼，請降，遣子難當及僚佐子弟數十人為質，碩德等引還。

translations.literal: Yao Shuode and others repeatedly defeated Yang Sheng; Sheng feared, asked to surrender, sent his son Nan Dang and several tens of sons and younger kin of staff officers as hostages; Shuode and others led the army back.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Shuode dealt Yang Sheng one defeat after another until Yang Sheng, desperate, sued for peace: he sent his son Nan Dang and dozens of officials’ sons as hostages, whereupon Shuode marched home.

sentences.zh: 署盛為使持節、散騎常侍、都督益、甯州諸軍事、征南大將軍、開府、益州牧、武都侯。

translations.literal: He appointed Sheng Bearer of the Credentials, Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, Area Commander for all military affairs in Yi and Ning provinces, General Who Conquers the South, Opening Office with separate establishment, Shepherd of Yi Province, Marquis of Wudu.
translations.idiomatic: He invested Yang Sheng with the credential-bearing commission, the title of Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, regional command over Yi and Ning, the rank of General Who Conquers the South with independent headquarters, the governorship of Yi Province, and the marquisate of Wudu.

sentences.zh: 斂俱陷城固，徙漢中流人郭陶等三千餘家於關中。

translations.literal: Lian Ju captured Chenggu and relocated more than three thousand households of displaced persons from Hanzhong including Guo Tao to Guanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Lian Ju took Chenggu and resettled upward of three thousand displaced Hanzhong households—Guo Tao among them—in Guanzhong.

sentences.zh: 興班告境內及在朝文武，立名不得犯叔父緒及碩德之名，以彰殊禮。

translations.literal: Xing promulgated notice within the borders and to civil and military at court: in establishing names one must not infringe the names of his uncles Xu and Shuode, thereby to display extraordinary courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing issued an edict to the realm and the capital bureaucracy: no one might adopt characters tabooed by his uncles’ personal names—Yao Xu and Yao Shuode—so as to mark their singular honor.

sentences.zh: 興謙恭孝友，每見緒及碩德，如家人之禮，整服傾悚，言則稱字，車馬服玩，必先二叔，然後服其次者，朝廷大政，必諮之而後行。

translations.literal: Xing was modest, respectful, filial, and friendly; whenever he saw Xu and Shuode, it was like family ritual—he straightened garments and bowed in awe, in speech he used their styles; for carriages, horses, apparel, and playthings, he always presented to the two uncles first, then used what remained; for great court policies, he invariably consulted them before acting.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing comported himself with humility, filial piety, and brotherly regard: whenever he met Yao Xu or Yao Shuode he behaved as though at a family gathering—adjusting his dress, bowing low, and addressing them by their courtesy names. Fine mounts, gear, and curios went first to his two uncles; only the surplus reached his own household. Weighty decisions of state he never carried out until he had sought their counsel.

sentences.zh: 太史令郭黁言於興曰：「戌亥之歲，當有孤寇起於西北，宜慎其鋒。

translations.literal: Astrology Director Guo Fen said to Xing: “In the years of Xu and Hai there will be a lone bandit rising in the northwest; one ought to be wary of its edge.”
translations.idiomatic: Court Astrologer Guo Fen warned Yao Xing: “When the calendar reaches the Xu–Hai cycle, a solitary foe will stir in the northwest—do not underestimate its bite.”

sentences.zh: 起兵如流沙，死者如亂麻，戎馬悠悠會隴頭，鮮卑、烏丸居不安，國朝疲於奔命矣。

translations.literal: Raising troops will be like flowing sand; the dead like tangled hemp; war-horses long-roaming will gather at Longtou; Xianbei and Wuhuan will dwell unsettled; the dynastic court will weary running on missions.
translations.idiomatic: Armies will surge like desert sand, corpses tangle like tossed hemp; cavalry will mass beneath Long Mountain until Xianbei and Wuhuan have nowhere to rest easy, and the throne will exhaust itself answering every alarm.”

sentences.zh: 」時所在有泉水湧出，傳云飲則愈病，後多無驗。

translations.literal: At the time everywhere springs gushed forth; rumor said drinking them cured illness; later many had no verification.
translations.idiomatic: About then springs suddenly welled up across the land; people claimed the water healed sickness, though most such tales soon failed the test.

sentences.zh: 屢有妖人自稱神女，戮之乃止。

translations.literal: Repeatedly there were prodigy-persons who styled themselves divine maidens; only when they were executed did it stop.
translations.idiomatic: Charlatans kept declaring themselves heavenly maidens until the sword silenced them.

sentences.zh: 興大閱，自杜郵至於羊牧。

translations.literal: Xing held a great review from Duyou down to Yangmu.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing staged a grand military review along the stretch from Duyou to Yangmu.

sentences.zh: 興以姚碩德來朝，大赦其境內。

translations.literal: Because Yao Shuode came to court, Xing greatly pardoned within his borders.
translations.idiomatic: When Yao Shuode arrived for an audience, Yao Xing proclaimed a general amnesty throughout his domain.

sentences.zh: 及碩德歸於秦州，興送之，及雍乃還。

translations.literal: When Shuode returned to Qinzhou, Xing escorted him; when they reached Yong he returned.
translations.idiomatic: As Shuode headed back to Qinzhou, Yao Xing rode with him all the way to Yong before turning home.

sentences.zh: 禿髮傉檀獻興馬三千匹，羊三萬頭。

translations.literal: Tufa Nunan presented to Xing three thousand horses and thirty thousand head of sheep.
translations.idiomatic: Tufa Nunan sent Yao Xing three thousand horses and thirty thousand sheep.

sentences.zh: 興以為忠於己，乃署傉檀為涼州刺史，征涼州刺史王尚還長安。

translations.literal: Xing deemed him loyal to himself; thereupon he appointed Nunan Inspector of Liangzhou and summoned Inspector of Liangzhou Wang Shang back to Chang’an.
translations.idiomatic: Convinced of Nunan’s loyalty, Yao Xing named him inspector of Liangzhou and recalled Inspector Wang Shang to Chang’an.

sentences.zh: 涼州人申屠英等二百餘人，遣主簿胡威詣興，請留尚，興弗許。

translations.literal: More than two hundred Liangzhou people including Shen Tu Ying sent Registrar Hu Wei to visit Xing to request retaining Shang; Xing did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: Over two hundred Liangzhou notables, Shen Tu Ying among them, dispatched Chief Clerk Hu Wei to beg Yao Xing to let Wang Shang stay; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 引威見之，威流涕謂興曰：「臣州奉國五年，王威不接，銜膽棲冰、孤城獨守者，仰恃陛下威靈，俯杖良牧惠化。

translations.literal: He led Wei to see him; Wei wept and said to Xing: “Our province has served the state five years; royal awe does not reach us; those who hold gall and dwell on ice, lone cities guarding alone, above rely on Your Majesty’s awesome power, below lean on a good shepherd’s kindly transformation.”
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing received Hu Wei, who said through tears: “For five years Liangzhou has flown your banner though no imperial majesty has touched our border. Those of us who slept on frost and swallowed bitterness, holding ruined towns alone, clung to Your Majesty’s distant prestige above and to our governor’s humane rule below.”

sentences.zh: 忽違天人之心，以華土資狄。

translations.literal: Suddenly violating the hearts of Heaven and men, you take Chinese soil and endow the Di.
translations.idiomatic: Now you would turn Heaven and men against you by handing Chinese soil to barbarian chieftains.”

sentences.zh: 若傉檀才望應代，臣豈敢言。

translations.literal: If Nunan’s talent and reputation fit succession, your servant how would dare speak.
translations.idiomatic: Had Nunan’s merit truly suited him to replace Wang Shang, I would hold my tongue.”

sentences.zh: 竊聞乃以臣等貿馬三千匹，羊三萬口，如所傳實者，是為棄人貴畜。

translations.literal: Privately I have heard that you trade us for three thousand horses and thirty thousand head of sheep; if the rumor is true, this is discarding people and prizing livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Whisperers say we were sold for three thousand horses and thirty thousand sheep—if that is true, you prize livestock above human lives.”

sentences.zh: 苟以馬供軍國，直煩尚書一符，三千餘家戶輸一匹，朝下夕辦，何故以一方委此奸胡！

translations.literal: If it be horses to supply army and state, it would simply vex the Minister with one tally—three thousand-odd households each delivering one horse, morning order evening completion—why for one region entrust this to this treacherous Hu!
translations.idiomatic: If horses alone were wanted for army and state, a single writ from the Ministry could levy one mount from each of three thousand households—done by nightfall. Why surrender an entire province to that treacherous Hu!”

sentences.zh: 昔漢武傾天下之資，開建河西，隔絕諸戎，斷匈奴右臂，所以終能屠大宛王毋寡。

translations.literal: Formerly Han Wu poured out the realm’s resources, opened and built Hexi, isolated the various Rong, cut off the Xiongnu’s right arm; therefore in the end he was able to slaughter the King of Dayuan, Wu-gua.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Han once poured the empire’s wealth into the Hexi corridor, walling off the western tribes and severing the Xiongnu right wing—only thus could he eventually behead the king of Dayuan, Wu-gua.”

sentences.zh: 今陛下方布政玉門，流化西域，奈何以五郡之地資之犬嚴狁，忠誠華族棄之虐虜！

translations.literal: Now Your Majesty is just spreading governance at Jade Gate, flowing transformation into the Western Regions—how can you take the territory of five commanderies and endow it to dog Xianyun, loyal Chinese clans discard them to cruel captives!
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty is only now extending edicts beyond the Jade Gate and spreading civilization westward—how can you barter five commanderies to Xianyun wolves and cast loyal Han houses to cruel nomads!”

sentences.zh: 非但臣州裏塗炭，懼方為聖朝旰食之憂。

translations.literal: Not only will your servant’s province within be mud and charcoal; I fear it will become the sage court’s worry of eating late.
translations.idiomatic: Not only will my province burn; I fear it will become the sort of crisis that keeps Your Majesty from his evening meal.”

sentences.zh: 」興乃遣西平人車普馳止王尚，又遣使喻傉檀。

translations.literal: Xing then sent Che Pu of Xiping to gallop and stop Wang Shang; he also sent envoys to instruct Nunan.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Yao Xing sent Che Pu of Xiping racing ahead to halt Wang Shang and dispatched another envoy to warn Nunan.

sentences.zh: 會傉檀已至姑臧，普以狀先告之。

translations.literal: It happened that Nunan had already reached Guzang; Pu informed him of the situation first.
translations.idiomatic: But Nunan had already entered Guzang; Che Pu reached him first with the news.

sentences.zh: 傉檀懼，脅遣王尚，遂入姑臧。

translations.literal: Nunan feared; he coerced sending Wang Shang away; thereupon entered Guzang.
translations.idiomatic: Alarmed, Nunan bullied Wang Shang out of the city and marched in.

sentences.zh: 尚既至長安，坐匿呂氏宮人，擅殺逃人薄禾等，禁止南台。

translations.literal: When Shang reached Chang’an, he sat guilty of hiding Lü-house palace women and on his own authority killing fugitive people Bo He and others; he was confined at the Southern Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: Once Wang Shang arrived in Chang’an, authorities charged him with harboring ladies of the former Lü court and executing fugitives such as Bo He without warrant; he was locked up at the Southern Terrace.

sentences.zh: 涼州別駕宗敞、治中張穆、主簿邊憲、胡威等上疏理尚曰：

translations.literal: Liangzhou Assistant Administrator Zong Chang, Adjunct Zhang Mu, Registrars Bian Xian and Hu Wei and others submitted a memorial reasoning for Shang, saying:
translations.idiomatic: Zong Chang, Liangzhou’s chief clerk, together with Zhang Mu, Bian Xian, Hu Wei, and others petitioned in Wang Shang’s defense:

sentences.zh: 臣州荒裔，鄰帶寇仇，居泰無垂拱之安，運否離傾覆之難。

translations.literal: Our province is a wild borderland, neighboring and belted by bandit foes; dwelling in peace we have no draped-arms ease; when fortune turns ill we part from overturning disaster.
translations.idiomatic: “Our province lies on a barbarous march, ringed by enemies. Even in calm years we enjoy no effortless peace; when fate turns cruel, we face utter ruin.

sentences.zh: 自張氏頹基，德風絕而莫扇；

translations.literal: Since the Zhang clan’s collapsed foundation, virtuous wind has ended and none fans it;
translations.idiomatic: Since the Zhang dynasty’s foundations crumbled, no kindly breeze has stirred to revive them;

sentences.zh: 呂數將終，梟鶚以之翻翔。

translations.literal: the Lü reckoning was about to end; owls and kites thereby wheeled and soared.
translations.idiomatic: when the Lü regime neared its term, owls and kites wheeled in its dying sky.

sentences.zh: 群生嬰罔極之痛，西夏有焚如之禍。

translations.literal: The myriad born encounter boundless pain; the western Xia had burn-like calamity.
translations.idiomatic: The people tasted measureless grief; the western regions knew the scourge of fire.”

sentences.zh: 幸皇鑒降眷，純風遠被。

translations.literal: Fortunately imperial mirror lowered regard; pure wind was spread afar.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven looked down with mercy; your civilizing wind reached even us.

sentences.zh: 刺史王尚受任垂滅之州，策成難全之際，輕身率下，躬儉節用，勞逸豐約，與眾同之，勸課農桑，時無廢業。

translations.literal: Inspector Wang Shang received appointment in a state about to perish, at a juncture when completion was hard to preserve; he lightened body and led those below, personally was frugal and restrained use; toil and ease, abundance and thrift, he shared with the multitude; he urged and supervised farming and sericulture; seasons had no abandoned tasks.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector Wang Shang took charge when our land was almost lost and survival hung by a thread. He shared every hardship with the people—labors and leisure, feast and famine—lived modestly, and pushed farming and silk work until no season lay idle.

sentences.zh: 然後振王威以掃不庭，回天波以蕩氛穢。

translations.literal: Thereafter he roused royal awe to sweep the unsubmissive, turned back Heaven’s wave to wash away miasma and filth.
translations.idiomatic: Only then did he unfurl imperial majesty to subdue rebels and turn your cleansing tide upon corruption.”

sentences.zh: 則群逆冰摧，不俟硃陽之曜；

translations.literal: Then the crowd of rebels ice-shattered; one does not await cinnabar sun’s radiance;
translations.idiomatic: The traitors shattered like thaw ice—no need to wait for midsummer sun;

sentences.zh: 若秋霜隕籜，豈待勁風之威。

translations.literal: like autumn frost felling bamboo sheaths—how wait for fierce wind’s might.
translations.idiomatic: they fell like bamboo struck by autumn frost—no gust required.”

sentences.zh: 何定遠之足高，營平之獨美！

translations.literal: How is Dingyuan alone lofty, Yingping alone beautiful!
translations.idiomatic: Why exalt only Ban Chao of Dingyuan or praise Zhao Chongguo of Yingping alone!”

sentences.zh: 經始甫爾，會朝算改授，使希世之功不終於必成，易失之機踐之而莫展。

translations.literal: The founding had just begun when court reckoning changed appointment, causing age-rare merit not to finish in certain completion, easy-lost opportunity stepped on yet not spread.
translations.idiomatic: His work had scarcely begun when the court reassigned him, cutting short a deed that might have rivaled history’s finest and leaving a fleeting chance trampled, unrealized.

sentences.zh: 當其時而明其事者，誰不慨然！

translations.literal: Those who at that time understood the matter—who did not sigh deeply!
translations.idiomatic: Who, knowing the truth of that hour, could withhold a bitter sigh!”

sentences.zh: 既遠役遐方，劬勞於外，雖效未酬恩，而在公無闕。

translations.literal: Already far laboring in distant region, toiling outside; although merit has not repaid grace, yet in public duty there is no lack.
translations.idiomatic: Though service on that distant frontier earned him no fitting reward, he never failed the public trust.”

sentences.zh: 自至京師，二旬於今，出車之命莫逮，萋斐之責惟深。

translations.literal: Since arriving at the capital, twenty days until now; the order to issue cart has not reached; the blame of calumny is only deep.
translations.idiomatic: Since he reached the capital twenty days ago, no summons to duty has come—only slander piles deeper.”

sentences.zh: 以取呂氏宮人裴氏及殺逃人薄禾等為南台所禁，天鑒玄鏡，暫免圇圄，譏繩之文，未離簡墨。

translations.literal: Because taking Lü-house palace woman Lady Pei and killing fugitive people Bo He and others, he was confined by the Southern Terrace; Heaven’s mirror mysterious mirror, temporarily spared prison; ridicule-cord’s documents have not left bamboo ink.
translations.idiomatic: He stands accused of sheltering a Lü-clan concubine surnamed Pei and executing fugitives such as Bo He—charges that led the Southern Terrace to jail him. Heaven’s judgment may have paused his fetters, yet the indictment’s ink has not dried.”

sentences.zh: 裴氏年垂知命，首發二毛，嫠居本家，不在尚室，年邁姿陋，何用送為！

translations.literal: Lady Pei’s years hang toward knowing fate; head hair sprouts two colors; widow dwelling in original house; she is not in Shang’s chamber; years advanced appearance ugly—what use sending!
translations.idiomatic: That Lady Pei nears fifty, her hair streaked with grey, widowed in her own kin’s house—never Wang Shang’s consort—and plain with age: why pretend she was ‘presented’ to him!”

sentences.zh: 邊籓耍捍，眾力是寄，禾等私逃，罪應憲墨，以殺止殺，安邊之義也。

translations.literal: Border ramparts play defense; multitudes’ force is entrusted; He and others privately fled; guilt should match legal ink; using killing to stop killing is the meaning of pacifying border.
translations.idiomatic: Frontiers depend on collective strength: Bo He and his fellows were deserters felons—death was statutory. To kill lawbreakers to still the frontier is precisely how peace is kept.”

sentences.zh: 假若以不送裴氏為罪者，正闕奚官之一女子耳。

translations.literal: Suppose taking not sending Lady Pei as crime—it is exactly lacking one woman of the Xiguan office.
translations.idiomatic: If omitting to hand over one palace maid is crime, the tally is short by a single missing servant girl.”

sentences.zh: 論勳則功重，言瑕則過微。

translations.literal: Discussing merit then merit is heavy; speaking flaws then fault is slight.
translations.idiomatic: Weighed for merit, his deeds tower; weighed for fault, the blemish is slight.”

sentences.zh: 而執憲吹毛求疵，忘勞記過，斯先哲所以泣血于當年，微臣所以仰天而灑淚。

translations.literal: Yet those who grasp statute blow fur seeking flaws, forget toil and record fault—this is why former wise ones wept blood in that year; why your petty servant looks to Heaven and sprinkles tears.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the law officers hunt for the slightest flaw, blind to his sweat—precisely why worthies of old wept blood, and why your servants lift tear-streaked faces to the sky.”

sentences.zh: 且尚之奉國，曆事二朝，能否效於既往，優劣簡在聖心，就有微過，功足相補，宜弘罔極之施，以彰覆載之恩。

translations.literal: Moreover Shang’s serving the state has served two courts in succession; able or not, efficacy lies in the past; good and bad are selected in the sage heart; even if there be slight fault, merit suffices to compensate; one ought to extend boundless bestowal, thereby to display covering-bearing grace.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shang has served two reigns; his record speaks plainly to your sage discernment. Even if a small fault attaches, his deeds outweigh it—grant him Heaven-wide mercy and show the breadth of your favor.”

sentences.zh: 臣等生自西州，無翰飛之翼，久沈偽政，絕進趣之途。

translations.literal: We and others were born from western province; we have no brush-flying wings; long sunk in false rule; cut off paths of advance and aspiration.
translations.idiomatic: We hail from the western marches without wings to fly to court, long trapped under usurpers and barred from honorable office.”

sentences.zh: 及皇化既沾，投竿之心冥發，遂策名委質，位忝吏端。

translations.literal: When imperial transformation had already moistened, the heart to cast aside pole darkly arose; thereupon registering name and entrusting substance, position humbly occupies clerk’s end.
translations.idiomatic: Once your civilization touched us, our hearts pledged loyalty unbidden; we inscribed our names and took humble posts.”

sentences.zh: 主辱臣憂，故重繭披款，惟陛下亮之。

translations.literal: Lord humiliated, ministers worry; therefore double-callus open sincerity; only Your Majesty brighten it.
translations.idiomatic: A lord’s shame is his servants’ grief—hence we blister our feet again to lay bare our plea; may Your Majesty understand.”

sentences.zh: 興覽之大悅，謂其黃門侍郎姚文祖曰：「卿知宗敞乎？

translations.literal: Xing read it and was greatly pleased; he said to his Palace Gate Gentleman Yao Wenzhu: “Do you know Zong Chang?”
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing read the memorial with delight and asked his Palace Gate Gentleman Yao Wenzhu, “Do you know Zong Chang?”

sentences.zh: 」文祖曰：「與臣州裏，西方之英雋。

translations.literal: Wenzhu said: “With your servant same province; of the west’s heroic excellence.”
translations.idiomatic: Wenzhu replied, “He is a countryman of mine—a brilliant man of the western frontier.”

sentences.zh: 」興曰：「有表理王尚，文義甚佳，當王尚研思耳。

translations.literal: Xing said: “There is a memorial reasoning Wang Shang; literary meaning very excellent—it must be Wang Shang’s polished thought.”
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing said, “This defense of Wang Shang is superbly written—it must be Wang Shang’s own careful prose.”

sentences.zh: 」文祖曰：「尚在南台，禁止不與賓客交通，敞寓於楊桓，非尚明矣。

translations.literal: Wenzhu said: “Shang is at the Southern Terrace; forbidden and does not communicate with guests; Chang lodges with Yang Huan—not Shang is clear.”
translations.idiomatic: Wenzhu answered, “Wang Shang is confined on the Southern Terrace, forbidden all visitors. Zong Chang is staying with Yang Huan—the author cannot be Wang Shang.”

sentences.zh: 」興曰：「若爾，桓為措思乎？

translations.literal: Xing said: “If so, did Huan set the thought?”
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing asked, “Then did Yang Huan set brush to it?”

sentences.zh: 」文祖曰：「西方評敞甚重，優於楊桓。

translations.literal: Wenzhu said: “The west appraises Chang very heavily; superior to Yang Huan.”
translations.idiomatic: “Western scholars rank Zong Chang far above Yang Huan.”

sentences.zh: 敞昔與呂超周旋，陛下試可問之。

translations.literal: Chang formerly with Lü Chao circled and turned; Your Majesty try may ask him.
translations.idiomatic: He once moved in Lü Chao’s circle—Your Majesty might ask him.”

sentences.zh: 」興因謂超曰：「宗敞文才何如？

translations.literal: Xing therefore said to Chao: “Zong Chang’s literary talent—how?”
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing turned to Lü Chao. “What do you make of Zong Chang’s literary gifts?”

sentences.zh: 可是誰輩？

translations.literal: Can be which sort of person?
translations.idiomatic: To whom would you compare him?”

sentences.zh: 」超曰：「敞在西土，時論甚美，方敞魏之陳、徐，晉之潘、陸。

translations.literal: Chao said: “Chang in the western soil—contemporary discussion very fine—compare Chang to Wei’s Chen and Xu, Jin’s Pan and Lu.”
translations.idiomatic: Lü Chao said, “Among western scholars he is celebrated—the sort of writer Wei paired with Chen Lin and Xu Gan, Jin with Pan Yue and Lu Ji.”

sentences.zh: 」即以表示超曰：「涼州小地，寧有此才乎？

translations.literal: Thereupon taking the memorial showed Chao and said: “Liangzhou small land—can there be this talent?”
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing handed him the memorial. “Liangzhou is a petty corner—could it breed such a talent?”

sentences.zh: 」超曰：「臣以敞余文比之，未足稱多。

translations.literal: Chao said: “Your servant comparing Chang’s remaining writings to it—not enough to call much.”
translations.idiomatic: Lü Chao replied, “Set beside his other compositions, this piece is hardly remarkable.”

sentences.zh: 琳琅出於昆嶺，明珠生於海濱，若必以地求人，則文命大夏之棄夫，姬昌東夷之擯士。

translations.literal: Fine jade comes from Kun peaks; bright pearls are born by sea margin—if one must by land seek men, then Wenming was great Xia’s cast-off husband, Jichang eastern Yi’s rejected scholar.
translations.idiomatic: Treasured jade comes from Kunlun’s ridges; lustrous pearls wash ashore—yet if birthplaces alone qualified men, Yu the Great would remain a Xia outcast and King Wen a barbarian reject.”

sentences.zh: 但當問其文彩何如，不可以區宇格物。

translations.literal: Only ought ask its literary color how—cannot by regions measure things.
translations.idiomatic: Judge the prose on its merits—do not fence genius inside provincial borders.”

sentences.zh: 」興悅，赦尚之罪，以為尚書。

translations.literal: Xing was pleased; he pardoned Shang’s crimes; appointed him Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Pleased, Yao Xing absolved Wang Shang and appointed him Minister of the Masters of Writing.
